deposit_months_limit.description: Flag a deposit above this many months' rent (1-12; app/src/config.ts).

rent_rise_pct_limit.description: Flag a yearly rent rise above this percentage (1-50).

notice_days_min.description: Flag a notice period shorter than this many days (1-90).

cloud_on_medium.description: Ask cloud Gemini for a second opinion when the on-device model says ok but a rule raised a medium finding.

cloud_model.description: Cloud model for the masked second opinion (must start with gemini-).
